records.title: Housing developments: urban lot split: owner-occupancy.
records.summary: Would instead require the local agency to require an applicant to select one of 2 sets of owner-occupancy requirements.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add the applicant’s owner-occupancy choice and required affidavit to the applicable lot-split application checklist.

records.title: Wildfire.
records.summary: Would require the department, on or before July 1, 2029, in consultation with the Department of Insurance, the Natural Resources Agency, the Office of Emergency Services, and other relevant departments, to develop standards for state and local agencies to aggregate and make available data related to parcel-, neighborhood-, and community-level wildfire risk for the purpose of enabling a wildfire data sharing platform.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: Monitor the state wildfire plan; no County Safety Element amendment until a local requirement or new map is issued.

records.title: Public Lands Protection Act.
records.summary: The measure, the Public Lands Protection Act, would, upon transfer to any private or nonfederal entity of a parcel of land located within the state that is owned by the United States government on or after January 1, 2025, and that has been designated in an adopted general plan or zoning ordinance as open space, public land, resource conservation, or an equivalent conservation-oriented designation, immediately subject that parcel to the zoning designation and associated state and local restrictions.
records.county_impact: First-pass zoning or development-standard cross-check with Title 8, Division 2; confirm the exact section before drafting changes.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, screen transferred federal land designated open space or public land on the Countywide Plan and zoning maps before a new entitlement.

records.title: Prohousing enhanced infrastructure financing districts.
records.summary: Would authorize a city or county that is designated as prohousing to establish a prohousing enhanced infrastructure financing district if applicable criteria are met. Would prescribe requirements applicable to those districts.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, decide with County finance staff whether a prohousing financing district is useful; no mandatory Title 8 change.

records.title: Transit-oriented housing developments: alternative plans.
records.summary: Would provide that a transit-oriented development alternative plan may reduce the capacity in up to one transit-oriented development zone in total units or residential floor area by more than 50% if applicable criteria are met.
records.county_impact: First-pass Policy Plan or housing-element cross-check; identify a plan amendment only after confirming the bill applies to the County.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check any transit-oriented alternative plan against the one-zone capacity reduction limit before a Policy Plan amendment.

records.title: Permit Streamlining Act: housing development projects: conformity with ordinances and standards.
records.summary: Applies a reasonable person consistency test to Permit Streamlining Act reviews of housing developments and emergency shelters. Substantial evidence supporting a reasonable finding of consistency with an applicable plan or standard would establish conformity; transient lodging portions are excluded.
records.county_impact: Proposed housing consistency rules could change how County standards and permit records are applied; review the exact provisions.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, train housing and shelter reviewers to document the reasonable-person consistency finding against the Policy Plan and objective Title 8 standards.

records.title: General plan elements: childcare.
records.summary: Would require a city, county, or city and county, no later than January 1, 2033, to prepare and adopt a childcare plan or integrate a childcare plan into the next adoption of the city, county, or city and county’s general plan to address the childcare needs of the jurisdiction.
records.county_impact: Would add childcare planning to the General Plan; track the proposed adoption window and compare existing Policy Plan policies.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add a childcare-plan milestone to the Policy Plan work program or prepare a standalone plan by the bill’s deadline.

records.title: Local government assistance: Regional Early Action Planning Fund.
records.summary: Would establish the Regional Early Action Planning Fund in the State Treasury for the purpose of providing councils of governments, regional entities, and jurisdictions with one-time funding, including grants for planning activities, to enable those entities to meet the 7th and subsequent cycles of the regional housing need assessment. Would require the department to allocate funds, upon appropriation by the Legislature, from the Regional Early Action Planning Fund to each council of governments or regional entity responsible for allocating regional housing need that applies and qualifies for those moneys.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check REAP grant eligibility for the next Housing Element planning cycle; no current Code amendment.

records.title: Building standards: affordable housing developments: electric vehicle charging.
records.summary: Allows affordable housing developments with permit applications submitted from January 2025 through December 2028 to meet electric vehicle charging receptacle requirements under either the 2025 California Green Building Standards Code or the 2024 supplement to the 2022 code. Local building departments enforce the applicable standard.
records.county_impact: BnS to check for this requirement
records.recommended_action: If enacted, send the two EV charging-code options and sunset to Building & Safety for affordable-housing plan checks; no LUS Planning amendment identified.

records.title: Single-family and multifamily housing units: preapproved plans.
records.summary: Would require each local agency, to develop a program for the preapproval of single-family and multifamily residential housing plans, whereby the local agency accepts single-family and multifamily plan submissions for preapproval and approves or denies the preapproval applications. Would require a large jurisdiction, to develop this program by July 1, 2027, and a small jurisdiction, to develop a program by January 1, 2029.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, coordinate residential preapproved-plan intake and approval clocks with Building & Safety; update shared instructions if Planning participates.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: expedited judicial review: sustainable aviation fuel projects.
records.summary: Allows the Governor to certify up to three sustainable aviation fuel projects for expedited CEQA judicial review as infrastructure projects.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check the CEQA intake screen for the affected exemption or analysis; revise County notices only where it is the lead agency.

records.title: Planning and zoning: housing elements: affirmatively furthering fair housing.
records.summary: Would remove the requirement on cities and counties to include the 2nd analysis in their housing elements.
records.county_impact: First-pass Policy Plan or housing-element cross-check; identify a plan amendment only after confirming the bill applies to the County.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, remove the superseded analysis from the next Housing Element work plan and use HCD’s standardized report when issued.

records.title: Natural resources: equitable outdoor access: 30x30 goal: urban nature-based projects.
records.summary: Would provide that, to advance and promote environmental, conservation, and public access policies and budget actions, the Governor’s office, state agencies, and the Legislature, when distributing resources, shall recognize the coequal goals and benefits of the 30x30 goal and the Outdoors for All initiative, and, to the extent practical, maximize investment in historically underserved urban communities consistent with those initiatives.
records.county_impact: No LUS Planning code or process change identified in the current bill status.
records.recommended_action: No Development Code, Countywide Plan, or LUS Planning workflow change identified from this bill.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: tribal cultural resources: mitigation measures.
records.summary: Expands the definition of tribal cultural resource to include places and objects identified by a California Native American tribe as culturally valuable, affecting CEQA resource review.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, update tribal-cultural-resource screening and consultation in CEQA checklists.

records.title: Planning and zoning: annual report: emergency shelter.
records.summary: Expands a homelessness program report to include allocated government funding and outreach to unhoused people.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add funding and outreach fields to homelessness program reporting if LUS Planning prepares the report.

records.title: Surplus lands: exempt surplus land: City of Ontario.
records.summary: Adds qualifying City of Ontario land to the exempt surplus land category, with recorded covenants governing its disposal.
records.county_impact: No LUS Planning code or process change identified in the current bill status.
records.recommended_action: No Development Code, Countywide Plan, or LUS Planning workflow change identified from this bill.

records.title: Unlawfully restrictive covenants: redevelopment of commercial property for residential uses.
records.summary: Narrows the commercial property redevelopment housing rule by excluding certain projects in charter cities that meet the bill’s criteria.
records.county_impact: The proposed exception concerns qualifying charter cities and covenant review; no County LUS zoning change is identified.
records.recommended_action: No Development Code, Countywide Plan, or LUS Planning workflow change identified from this bill.

records.title: Housing Crisis Act of 2019.
records.summary: Expands the Housing Crisis Act restriction on local policies or standards that operate as a housing development moratorium.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, review Title 8 policies and conditions for de facto housing moratoria barred by the Housing Crisis Act.

records.title: Accessory dwelling units: private sewage disposal systems.
records.summary: Would prohibit a local agency from prohibiting an accessory dwelling unit in an area solely because the lots are served by private sewage disposal systems. Would prohibit a local health officer from withholding approval based on a minimum lot size requirement if the private sewage disposal system meets certain operating requirements established by the State Water Resources Control Board and the regional water quality control board for that lot size.
records.county_impact: Would affect ADU approvals using private septic; compare Chapter 84.36.050(f) and obtain EHS review.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, compare Chapter 84.36 septic criteria with the ban on rejecting ADUs solely for private sewage; coordinate health-officer review with EHS.

records.title: Wildfire prevention: local assistance grant program: eligible activities.
records.summary: Would expand eligible activities under the local assistance grant program to include projects undertaken by a local governmental entity involving the acquisition or installation of mobile rigid dip tanks or similar mobile and permanent infrastructure that is capable of providing helicopter-accessible water supplies for firefighting response or suppression purposes in very high fire and high fire hazard severity zones.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, ask County Fire whether mobile dip tanks fit a local-assistance grant project; no Planning Code change identified.

records.title: Greenhouse gases: soil carbon sequestration.
records.summary: Would additionally require that expert advisory committee to include an expert in soil carbon sequestration. Would establish the Climate-smart Organics Management for Protecting Our Soil and Terrain (COMPOST) Act of 2026.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning change; the state compost advisory committee and program own implementation.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: overburdened communities: notices and hearings: translations.
records.summary: Requires environmental review of new or expanded industrial uses near sensitive receptors, with the lead agency choosing an EIR, negative declaration, or mitigated negative declaration under the bill’s criteria.
records.county_impact: Proposed CEQA translation duties could change County environmental notices and EJFA outreach; compare Chapter 85.03 and planned Chapter 85.22.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add industrial-project proximity to sensitive receptors to CEQA intake screening and document the lead agency’s EIR, ND, or MND determination.

records.title: General plan: annual report: shelter beds.
records.summary: Adds counts of temporary emergency shelter beds and permanent housing units serving people experiencing or leaving homelessness to annual planning agency reports beginning in 2028.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add emergency-shelter beds and permanent-housing counts to the annual planning report template beginning with the 2028 report.

records.title: Fire safety: fire hazard severity zones.
records.summary: Requires the State Fire Marshal to publish proposed local fire hazard severity zone designations and notify local governments at least 180 days before finalizing them.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add the State Fire Marshal’s 180-day proposed-hazard-map notice to the County map-review calendar.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: natural hazards and adverse environmental conditions.
records.summary: Requires CEQA environmental impact reports to discuss significant effects of placing projects near, or attracting people to, existing or foreseeable natural hazards and adverse environmental conditions.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add future-occupant exposure to existing natural hazards to the EIR scope checklist for applicable projects.

records.title: General plan: safety element: very high fire hazard severity zones: insurance.
records.summary: Adds insurance availability for existing and planned uses in high wildfire hazard areas to safety elements updated from 2028 onward.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: General plan: safety element: very high fire hazard severity zones: insurance. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add insurance availability in very-high-fire-hazard and state-responsibility areas to the next Safety Element update scope.

records.title: Hazardous waste: site remediation: residential suitability guidelines.
records.summary: Would require the State Water Resources Control Board, working jointly with the department and in consultation with the Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation, to develop guidelines for developers and for agencies overseeing development-specific site remediations and making determinations of site suitability. Would require the board, in conjunction with the department, to develop thresholds of significance for contaminants from different sources and for different future uses.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: Monitor state hazardous-site streamlining guidance; add it to housing intake only when final eligibility rules exist.

records.title: Planning and zoning: housing element: interim housing units: acutely low income households.
records.summary: Would authorize a city or county that met or exceeded its need for emergency shelter capacity and that provides committed support for interim housing, to report the number of interim housing units receiving that support that are approved, as units approved or disapproved for acutely low income households, for purposes of the annual progress report.
records.county_impact: First-pass Policy Plan or housing-element cross-check; identify a plan amendment only after confirming the bill applies to the County.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check whether eligible interim-housing units can count toward emergency-shelter capacity in the next Housing Element/APR.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund: contributions.
records.summary: Would authorize a lead agency for a land use project to require an applicant to contribute to the Transit-Oriented Development Implementation Fund if certain cost conditions are met and the department and the office have validated the reductions in vehicle miles traveled that are attributable to the project.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, before imposing a TOD implementation-fund contribution, document the validated VMT reduction and cost limits against existing CEQA mitigation.

records.title: Housing element: inventory of land: substantial compliance.
records.summary: Clarifies that local zoning for multifamily housing sites can use overlay, mixed use, or combining districts if both owner occupied and rental multifamily uses are allowed.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Western Joshua Tree Conservation Act: life-sustaining services: take permit.
records.summary: Would authorize the department to permit the taking of a western Joshua tree without payment of fees or other mitigation upon demonstration to the department that the taking of a western Joshua tree is related to the maintenance, operation, or construction of a life-sustaining service connection to a single-family residence or multifamily residence, including distribution infrastructure.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: wireless telecommunications facility: broadband internet access projects.
records.summary: Would exempt from CEQA projects for the installation of a wireless telecommunications facility, or a broadband internet access project, that is not a small wireless facility.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add qualifying broadband and wireless facilities to CEQA exemption screening; check that the facility is outside the small-wireless category.

records.title: Exempt surplus land: locally owned land
records.summary: Adds qualifying local surplus land within a property and business improvement district to the exempt surplus land definition.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, screen qualifying surplus land in a property and business improvement district with Real Estate Services before disposition.

records.title: Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly on Faith-Based Lands Act of 2026.
records.summary: Would enact the Residential Care Facilities for the Elderly on Faith-Based Lands Act of 2026. Would require, notwithstanding any inconsistent provision of a local government’s general plan, specific plan, zoning ordinance, or regulation, that a residential care facility development project located on land owned by a religious institution be an allowable use at certain densities, if the development project satisfies all of the prescribed criteria.
records.county_impact: First-pass zoning or development-standard cross-check with Title 8, Division 2; confirm the exact section before drafting changes.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, compare faith-based elder-care facility eligibility with Title 8 use tables and the Policy Plan; create a qualifying application route.

records.title: Natural gas: appliances.
records.summary: Would prohibit state agencies and local governments from adopting or enforcing a rule, regulation, resolution, or ordinance that directly or indirectly results in prohibiting the use of gas appliances in residential or nonresidential buildings.
records.county_impact: First-pass zoning or development-standard cross-check with Title 8, Division 2; confirm the exact section before drafting changes.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check Title 8 or permit conditions for an appliance fuel restriction that the bill would bar; coordinate building-code questions with Building & Safety.

records.title: Short-term rentals: emergencies and special events.
records.summary: Would require both the Office of Emergency Services and the Office of Tourism to establish a public registration system. Would require the offices to adopt regulations to administer their respective public registration systems.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning change; state emergency and tourism offices own the registration systems.

records.title: Planning and zoning: housing element: regional housing needs allocation: judicial review.
records.summary: Would provide that the final determination by the council of governments or the delegate subregion is subject to judicial review.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, keep the COG final RHNA determination and judicial-review deadline in the Housing Element project file.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: notice: direct mailing: electronic mail.
records.summary: Would authorize a lead agency to satisfy the direct mailing requirements listed above by electronic mail if the recipient affirmatively requested to receive notice by electronic mail.
records.county_impact: Would allow CEQA direct notice by email on recipient request; compare the County notice process in §85.03.080.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add email delivery to CEQA notice procedures only for recipients who request it; retain proof of the request.

records.title: Wildfire: vegetation management: fuel reduction activities.
records.summary: Would, on or before January 1, 2028, and every 2 years thereafter, require the department or a local entity to conduct an assessment, of all undeveloped public lands for which it is primarily responsible for preventing and suppressing fires to ensure that the public land is not a severe fire hazard. Would require this assessment to be posted on the department’s and local entity’s internet website and would require a local entity conducting the assessment to submit its assessment to the department.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, identify any undeveloped County public land for which the County has fire-suppression responsibility; coordinate the biennial assessment with County Fire.

records.title: Infrastructure-constrained energization areas: energization timelines: environmental review.
records.summary: Requires the Public Utilities Commission to enforce electrical utility energization timelines and impose penalties for missed targets.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, no local CEQA or permit duty; utility energization timelines are enforced by the Public Utilities Commission.

records.title: Adaptive reuse: industrial zones.
records.summary: Excludes adaptive reuse of sites with existing high hazard Group H occupancy from the streamlined adaptive reuse process.
records.county_impact: First-pass zoning or development-standard cross-check with Title 8, Division 2; confirm the exact section before drafting changes.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, exclude existing Group H high-hazard occupancy sites from the adaptive-reuse ministerial eligibility checklist.

records.title: Regional housing need: affordable housing.
records.summary: Would authorize a local government, to enter into a voluntary agreement with another local government to allow new housing development projects to count toward each locality’s share of the regional housing needs allocation if applicable criteria are met, including that the project includes affordable housing units for very low and lower income households.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, decide with neighboring jurisdictions whether a voluntary RHNA-credit agreement is useful; document credits in Housing Element reporting if signed.

records.title: General plan: annual report: suite-style student housing quarters.
records.summary: Would additionally require the city or county to include in the annual report the number of suite-style student housing quarters, as determined by the department.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add suite-style student housing quarters to the APR data collection if the County has qualifying projects.

records.title: Surplus Land Act: exemptions: land unsuitable for housing.
records.summary: Expands exempt surplus land to include parcels unsuitable for housing because of hazards such as unstable slopes, landslides, subsidence, or liquefaction.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, add geologic-hazard documentation to surplus-land exemption screening with Real Estate Services.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemption: passenger rail service.
records.summary: Would instead eliminate the condition that the public project be exclusively used by zero-emission trains or certified Tier 4 or cleaner rolling stock or locomotives, thereby expanding the scope of the exemption. Would require, for purposes of the exemption, the mainline rail of the project, instead of the whole project, to be located entirely within an existing right-of-way or existing highway right-of-way.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, check whether a County rail project qualifies for the expanded CEQA exemption without an exclusive zero-emission or Tier 4 condition.

records.title: Accessory dwelling units: proof of residential occupancy requirements.
records.summary: Would additionally authorize a local agency to require the property owner to certify, that the accessory dwelling unit will be occupied as a residential dwelling unit for at least 6 months out of each calendar year. Would authorize the local agency to annually recertify, that the accessory dwelling unit is occupied as a residential dwelling unit for at least 6 months out of each calendar year.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: Accessory dwelling units: proof of residential occupancy requirements. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Planning and Zoning Law: housing elements: rezoning.
records.summary: Extends the deadline to complete required housing element rezoning after a late, noncompliant housing element from one year to 18 months after the statutory adoption deadline.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Publication: newspapers of general circulation.
records.summary: Would require any public notice that is legally required to be published in a newspaper of general circulation to be published in the newspaper’s print publication, on the newspaper’s internet website or electronic newspaper available on the internet, and on the statewide internet website maintained as a repository for notices by a majority of California newspapers of general circulation.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: Publication: newspapers of general circulation. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Composting facilities: zoning.
records.summary: The measure, on or before June 1, 2027, would require the Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation, in consultation with the Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery, to develop and post on the office’s internet website, a technical advisory, reflecting best practices to facilitate the siting of composting facilities to meet the organic waste reduction goals.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Density Bonus Law: incentives and concessions: green housing developments.
records.summary: Would require a city or county to grant additional incentives or concessions when an applicant proposes to construct a green housing development. Would require that the number of incentives or concessions granted initially be set to 3 and would require HCD, to evaluate and report on the number and type of units and developments entitled, permitted, and constructed pursuant to these provisions.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: Density Bonus Law: incentives and concessions: green housing developments. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Residential heat pump systems: water heaters and HVAC: installations.
records.summary: Would require a city, county, or city and county to adopt and offer asynchronous inspections for installations of residential heat pump water heater or heat pump HVAC systems, that do not require a licensed contractor and building inspector to be simultaneously present during the inspection.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Planning and zoning: very high fire hazard areas.
records.summary: Requires local safety elements to include a wildfire retrofit strategy, with periodic review, and land use elements in jurisdictions with homes in very high fire hazard areas to identify those areas and protective measures.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: Planning and zoning: very high fire hazard areas. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: State Fire Marshal: home hardening certification program.
records.summary: Would require, on or before January 1, 2027, the State Fire Marshal’s Wildfire Mitigation Advisory Committee to develop a home hardening certification program that identifies home hardening measures, including defensible space, that can be implemented during renovation or property improvement projects, or both, to substantially reduce the risk of loss during a fire and bring existing building stock into alignment with state building standards for wildland-urban interface areas.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: geothermal exploratory projects: geothermal field development projects: enhanced geothermal system wells.
records.summary: Expands geothermal exploratory project rules to include equipment and work connecting wells and reservoirs, and revises which wells count toward a distance limit.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Planning and zoning: housing element: regional housing needs allocation.
records.summary: Requires HCD to develop a standardized housing element reporting format by the end of 2026 and moves regional housing need determinations from two to three years before scheduled housing element revisions.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Energy: building standards: photovoltaic requirements.
records.summary: Would, until January 1, 2028, require residential construction intended to repair, restore, or replace a residential building damaged or destroyed as a result of a disaster in an area in which a state of emergency has been proclaimed by the Governor to comply only with the requirements regarding photovoltaic systems pursuant to those regulations, if any, that were in effect at the time the damaged or destroyed building was originally constructed and would prohibit that construction from being required to comply with any additional or conflicting photovoltaic system requirements in effect at the time of repair, restoration, or replacement.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Surplus land: exempt surplus land: sectional planning area.
records.summary: Changes an exempt surplus land provision for a defined sectional planning area and sets a minimum share of housing units outside academic institution housing.
records.county_impact: Inactive proposal: its requirements are not enacted; no implementation step is due.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Water resources: data centers.
records.summary: Would require a person who owns or operates a data center, prior to applying to a city or a county for an initial business license, equivalent instrument, or permit, to provide its water supplier, under penalty of perjury, an estimate of the expected water use. When applying to a city or county for an initial business license, the bill would require a person who owns or operates a data center to self-certify, under penalty of perjury, on the application that the person has provided its water supplier an estimate of the expected water use.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: Water resources: data centers. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: No LUS Planning implementation action; this bill did not become law.

records.title: Planning and zoning: logistics use developments: truck routes.
records.summary: Would clarify that a 21st century warehouse and a tier 1 21st century warehouse are required to comply with those standards as are in effect at the time that the building permit for a development of a 21st century warehouse is issued and make other clarifying changes relating to permissibility of use of conduits and electrical hookups at loading bays at those locations.
records.county_impact: Warehouse and truck route rules may affect County logistics conditions; cross-check existing County logistics standards.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, apply warehouse standards in force when the building permit is issued; check the date used in Title 8 review.

records.title: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: housing development projects: energy systems and electronics: labor standards.
records.summary: Would subject a rezoning that would allow for the construction of a bed and breakfast inn, motel, hotel, or other transient lodging to CEQA review even if the rezoning implements a schedule of actions contained in an approved housing element. Would specify that other transient lodging does not include a residential hotel, or a resident’s use or marketing of a unit as short-term lodging, in a manner that is consistent with local law.
records.county_impact: Potential LUS Planning impact: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: housing development projects: energy systems and electronics: labor standards. Review the official text for specific County duties, deadlines, and exemptions.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, keep transient-lodging rezonings on the CEQA review checklist even when they implement a Housing Element action.

records.title: General plan: annual report: congregate care for the elderly.
records.summary: Would, for the 7th and each subsequent revision of the housing element, authorize a planning agency to include in that report the number of units approved for congregate care for the elderly, for up to 15% of a jurisdiction’s regional housing need allocation for any income category.
records.county_impact: First-pass Policy Plan or housing-element cross-check; identify a plan amendment only after confirming the bill applies to the County.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, at the next Housing Element reporting review, decide whether to count qualifying congregate-care units within the allowed RHNA share.

records.title: Single-family and multifamily housing units: preapproved plans.
records.summary: Would require each local agency, to develop a program for the preapproval of single-family and multifamily residential housing plans, whereby the local agency accepts single-family and multifamily plan submissions for preapproval and approves or denies the preapproval applications. Would require a large jurisdiction, to develop this program by July 1, 2026, and a small jurisdiction, to develop a program by January 1, 2028.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, coordinate a preapproved single- and multifamily plan intake and reuse program with Building & Safety; define the County approval clock.

records.title: Wildfire safety: fuels reduction projects.
records.summary: Requires CalEPA and the Natural Resources Agency to report to the Legislature on implementation of an emergency proclamation. The digest identifies no new local planning duty.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: No new LUS step; CalEPA and the Natural Resources Agency own the emergency-proclamation report.

records.title: Housing developments: ordinances, policies, and standards.
records.summary: Would include in the definition of “ordinances, policies, and standards” materials requirements, postentitlement permit standards, and any rules, regulations, determinations, and other requirements adopted or implemented by other public agencies.
records.county_impact: Proposed housing consistency and permit standards could affect both Title 8 and application review; scope needs closer legal review.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, inventory postentitlement and materials requirements applied to housing; check which can be treated as objective standards under the bill.

records.title: Fire safety: fire hazard severity zones: State Fire Marshal.
records.summary: Would prohibit the State Fire Marshal’s determination of fire hazard severity zone, in both state responsibility areas and lands that are not state responsibility areas, from being based on risk mitigation activities. Would authorize the State Fire Marshal to provide a written response to an entity on actions that may impact the degree of fire hazard, and would require this written response to be posted on the State Fire Marshal’s internet website.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, do not use parcel-level mitigation work to alter State Fire Marshal hazard-zone designations in the Safety Element mapping.

records.title: Fire hazard severity zones: State Fire Marshal.
records.summary: Would instead require the State Fire Marshal, at least once every 5 years, to review areas in the state identified as moderate, high, and very high fire hazard severity zones, and to review lands within state responsibility areas classified as fire hazard severity zones. Would also require the State Fire Marshal, at least once every 5 years, to re-review areas within the state that are not identified as moderate, high, and very high fire hazard severity zones, and to re-review lands within state responsibility areas that are not classified as fire hazard severity zones, and, if applicable, identify or classify those areas.
records.county_impact: No immediate LUS Planning amendment identified; watch for implementing guidance or coordination with the responsible agency.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, track the five-year State Fire Marshal hazard-map review and update County GIS and Safety Element references when maps change.

records.title: Planning and Zoning Law: postentitlement phase permits: Housing Accountability Act.
records.summary: Would prohibit the local agency from requiring or requesting more than 2 plan check and specification reviews in connection with an application for a building permit, as part of its review, except. Would authorize a local agency to deny an application that is not compliant with the permit standards following 2 plan check and specification reviews.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.
records.recommended_action: If enacted, coordinate a two-cycle plan-check limit with Building & Safety; remove extra Planning resubmittal rounds on covered permits.

records.title: Endangered species: incidental take: wildfire preparedness activities.
records.summary: Would authorize a city, county, city and county, special district, or other local agency to submit to the department a wildfire preparedness plan to conduct wildfire preparedness activities on land designated as a fire hazard severity zone, that minimizes impacts to wildlife and habitat for candidate, threatened, and endangered species.
records.county_impact: First-pass permit, notice, CEQA, or reporting workflow cross-check; confirm the affected County process.

records.title: California Residential Private Permitting Review Act: residential building permits.
records.summary: Known as the California Residential Private Permitting Review Act , this bill requires counties prepare and post a fee schedule online. Local building depts must provide applicants with estimated timeframes for plan checks. If a dept needs more than 30 days to complete a plan check, applicants can hire private professionals to perform it. These private professionals must submit an affidavit and report to the building department, which then has 14 days to issue the permit or to notify applicants of non-compliance. The bill applies to specific new constructions and modifications of residential buildings.
